_about: Typical memory and CPU use of each module, for the dashboard, the phone's app library and the README. Memory is what the module's processes keep resident; measured on an emulator at idle where possible (see docs/releases/v0.9.6-beta.md), otherwise from the projects' own guidance. cpu is low, medium or high: what to expect while the module is busy.

ssh.note: A little more while copying files over SFTP.

web.note: Grows with traffic to your sites.

tunnel.note: Grows with the traffic it carries.

tailscale.note: Encrypts traffic in software, so large transfers keep a core busy.

camera.note: Only while streaming or recording. Uses more battery and warms the phone.

ai.note: Every core while it answers, nothing in between. A 1.5B model needs about 1.5 GB in all, a 3B model about 2.5 GB.

wol.note: Runs only while sending a wake-up packet.

repeater.note: Grows with the traffic of the devices on its network.

network.note: Scans and speed tests run only when you start them.

jellyfin.note: Light when your devices play files as they are. Converting video decodes it in software and can use every core.

qbittorrent.note: Grows with the number of active torrents. Checking a finished download is busy for a moment.

aria2.note: Grows with the number of active torrents; no web page of its own to keep in memory.

prowlarr.note: Busy for a few seconds during each search.

radarr.note: Busier while importing downloads or rescanning a large library.

sonarr.note: Busier while importing downloads or rescanning a large library.

seerr.note: Mostly idle; looks up movies and shows when you browse.

homeassistant.note: Depends on your integrations; low for most homes.

immich.note: Thumbnails and video conversion after uploads use every core, then it settles. Face and object recognition stay off.

stalwart.note: Spam checks add a little for each message.
